summary: Customer requests scheduled SIEM export with PII allowlist and retention-exception windows
description: Mercury Health (enterprise) requests: 1) recurring daily SIEM export of audit events (UTC 02:00) to their S3 bucket; 2) a customer-provided PII allowlist so selected fields (email, phone, patient_id) are preserved in exports for their internal matching; 3) a 90-day retention-exception window (legal_hold flag) for a named tenant subset; 4) delivery receipts with signed manifest and RFC3161 timestamp. They require a non-redacted copy for their forensic team for specific tenant IDs and a standard redacted copy for all others.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer provided example tenant IDs and requested schedule. 2) Reproduce by running current export job for tenant set under prod-us-west-2. 3) Observe that redaction pipeline currently strips PII globally; no allowlist mode present in prod. 4) Verify delivery manifest generation and presigned URL expiry behavior.

investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: redaction-service is configured with a global denylist; per-customer allowlist has not been rolled out. Check flag 'allowlist_mode' in redaction-service config. Reviewed recent deploys (PR 5009) and found no allowlist integration. SRE confirmed export pipeline can generate dual copies (redacted + raw) but raw export currently prevented by policy. Action items: 1) enable feature-flag allowlist-mode for a single test tenant; 2) patch redaction-service to honor customer-scoped allowlists; 3) schedule manual signed export for Mercury Health while patch is tracked; 4) produce audit trail of all changes and provide RFC3161 timestamps on manifests.
